blueprints.description: A support desk: a dashboard, the ticket queue and its board, ticket pages with quick actions, a public portal form and a knowledge base.

screens.name: support.dashboard
screens.title: Dashboard
screens.description: Open and overdue tickets, average response, tickets by priority and by assignee.

screens.name: support.queue
screens.title: Queue
screens.description: Every ticket, with the saved views Unassigned, Mine and Overdue.

screens.name: support.queue.board
screens.title: Queue board
screens.description: The same tickets as cards in a column for each status.

screens.name: support.queue.ticket
screens.title: Ticket
screens.description: One ticket: the conversation, its properties and the quick actions.

screens.name: support.queue.new
screens.title: New ticket
screens.description: Opens a ticket on behalf of a customer.

screens.name: support.queue.portal
screens.title: Contact support
screens.description: The public form a customer opens a ticket with, outside the application shell.

screens.name: support.customers
screens.title: Customers
screens.description: The people and organisations that write in.

screens.name: support.knowledge
screens.title: Knowledge base
screens.description: Articles by category on the left, the chosen article on the right.

templates.name: SupportDashboard
templates.description: Open and overdue tickets, average first response, tickets by priority and by assignee, and the overdue tickets.

templates.name: TicketQueue
templates.description: Every ticket with its priority and status as chips, filtered by status, priority, assignee and age, with the saved views Unassigned, Mine and Overdue.

templates.name: TicketBoard
templates.description: Tickets as cards in a column for each status.

templates.name: TicketPage
templates.description: One ticket: the conversation, its properties in the aside, and the quick actions assign, change status, escalate and merge.

templates.name: TicketCreateForm
templates.description: A form that opens a ticket on behalf of a customer.

templates.name: TicketPortalForm
templates.description: The public form a customer opens a ticket with, without application chrome.

templates.name: MyTickets
templates.description: The tickets assigned to the signed-in agent, with their priority and status as chips and how long each has waited.

templates.name: CustomerList
templates.description: The people and organisations that write in, with their plan, how many tickets they have open and when they last wrote.

templates.name: KnowledgeBase
templates.description: Categories and articles as a tree with search on the left, the chosen article on the right; a navigation stack on a phone.

templates.name: TicketQuickCreate
templates.description: A short form that opens a ticket without leaving the page.

templates.name: CustomerQuickCreate
templates.description: A short form that adds a customer without leaving the page.

templates.name: AssignTicket
templates.description: Assigns a ticket to an agent, with a note they will see.

templates.name: ChangeTicketStatus
templates.description: Moves a ticket to another status, with a comment.

templates.name: EscalateTicket
templates.description: Raises a ticket to another team or level, with the reason.

templates.name: MergeTickets
templates.description: Merges a duplicate ticket into another one, keeping the conversation.
